sourceChecks.text: When David had come to Mahanaim, Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がギレアド人バルジライを名指し、ロゲリムから来た人物またはダビデへの行動を記す。

sourceChecks.text: Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim; and he went over the Jordan with the king to conduct him over the Jordan.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がギレアド人バルジライを名指し、ロゲリムから来た人物またはダビデへの行動を記す。

sourceChecks.text: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even eighty years old. He had provided the king with sustenance while he stayed at Mahanaim, for he was a very great man.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がギレアド人バルジライを名指し、ロゲリムから来た人物またはダビデへの行動を記す。

sourceChecks.text: The king said to Barzillai, “Come over with me, and I will sustain you with me in Jerusalem.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がギレアド人バルジライを名指し、ロゲリムから来た人物またはダビデへの行動を記す。

sourceChecks.text: Barzillai said to the king, “How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がギレアド人バルジライを名指し、ロゲリムから来た人物またはダビデへの行動を記す。

sourceChecks.text: All the people went over the Jordan, and the king went over. Then the king kissed Barzillai and blessed him; and he returned to his own place.
